members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the Switch, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the Switch shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the Switch invalid by itself.

members.name: selected
members.doc: Whether the Switch is on, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultSelected
members.doc: Whether the Switch starts on, when it controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new on or off state each time it changes.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the Switch: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the Switch read-only: its state stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the Switch required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is off.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the Switch invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the Switch invalid.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named Switch submits its value while it is on.

members.name: value
members.doc: What a named Switch submits while it is on.

types.name: MuxUIAccessibleName

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the Switch. Without one, the Switch needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and children do not count as a name. When both label and children are given, label is shown.
